title: Staged capacity simulation and OKR binding for hosted model catalog
creator: Aisha Kapoor
project: Hosted API Model Catalog Seasonal Readiness
description:
Background: Recent traffic spikes in two pilot customers exposed that our current hosted model catalog sizing assumptions do not sufficiently capture short-window burst patterns. This ticket scopes a quarterly deliverable that couples a staged capacity simulation (deterministic + stochastic scenarios) with explicit OKR bindings so roadmap commitments reflect realistic capacity hedges.

What we will do: run a set of capacity simulations across three demand scenarios (baseline, peak-season, accidental-traffic-burst), produce a hedging matrix (how much dedicated vs. shared capacity to reserve per model tier), and map the outcomes to quarter-level OKR commitments (what features we can guarantee under each hedge). Deliver a decision playbook, recommended reserve bands, and a short engineering runbook for autoscaling and canary thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Simulation engine executed for baseline, peak, and burst scenarios with input traces attached
Hedge matrix produced showing dollars/TPS/percent-SLA tradeoffs for at least five representative models
OKR table mapping features (canary windows, model line promotions, new tier launches) to required reserve bands
Stakeholder sign-off from Eng infra, GTM, and SRE on hedge recommendations
Implementation plan and follow-up Linear tickets created for engineering changes
success_metrics: Reduce model-catalog incident frequency during burst windows by 50% (quarter-over-quarter)
Maintain 99.5% P95 latency for promoted hosted models under expected peak scenario
Cost increase for reserve band kept under 12% of current hosted spend for Q2
constraints_and_tradeoffs: Trade-offs: reserving capacity reduces cold-start risk but increases committed spend; wider hedges protect customers at higher cost. We will evaluate three cost tiers (conservative/moderate/aggressive) and recommend one with accompanying rollback triggers. Time constraint: simulations must complete before the April roadmap freeze; limited access to historical traces for new models requires synthetic trace augmentation.
